;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 lower Puna eruption]]
**23 passengers on a tour boat in [[Hawaii]] are injured after a [[lava bomb]] from the [[Kīlauea]] volcano punctures the roof of the vessel. [http://abc7.com/hawaii-lava-bomb-punctures-boats-roof-injures-12-passengers/3772674/ (KABC-TV)]
*An intense heatwave kills at least 14 people in [[Japan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-weather-japan-heatwave/heatwave-blankets-japan-kills-14-people-over-long-weekend-idUSKBN1K709Q (Reuters)]
*Heavy flooding in [[Nigeria]] kills 44 people and 20 others are missing. [https://allafrica.com/stories/201807170005.htm (All Africa)]
*Five bodies are recovered from MV ''Shunqiang 2'', which sank the day before after colliding with another ship near [[Shanghai]].  [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-07/16/c_137328850.htm (Xinhua)]
*A ship catches fire at the [[Gadani ship-breaking yard]] in [[Pakistan]], trapping four workers inside.  [https://tribune.com.pk/story/1759412/1-least-four-trapped-cargo-ship-catches-fire-gadani-shipbreaking-yard/ (''The Tribune'')]
*A road collision involving a broken-down bus kills at least 17 people and injures at least 11 others in [[Hyderabad, Sindh|Hyderabad]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://tribune.com.pk/story/1758995/1-15-die-several-injured-hyderabad-road-accident/ (''The Tribune'')]
*Two vessels deliver 25 survivors and one [[Peru]]vian corpse from [[Spain|Spanish]] ship MV ''Dorneda'' to ports in [[Argentina]] and [[Patagonia]]. One crewman remains missing after the [[fishing trawler]] sank off Argentina. [https://www.journalducameroun.com/en/25-survivors-of-ship-sinking-reach-ports-in-south-america/ (''The Journal du Cemron'')]
*An explosion in a coal mine in [[Tkibuli]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]], kills four people and injures six others. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/todays-headlines/georgia-at-least-4-miners-killed-in-mine-explosion/1205364 (A.A.)]
*A gas explosion at a hotel in [[Multan]], [[Pakistan]], kills three people and injures 25 others. [https://nation.com.pk/16-Jul-2018/3-dead-25-injured-in-multan-hotel-explosion (''The Nation'')]

;International relations
*[[2018 Russia–United States summit]]
**[[President of the United States|United States President]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] meet in [[Helsinki]]. [https://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/trump-begins-helsinki-summit-with-putin-with-hope-for-extraordinary-relationship_us_5b4c8093e4b0bc69a7892b55 (''Huffington Post'')]
**Trump reiterates his position that Russia did not [[Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections|interfere]] in the [[2016 United States presidential election|2016 US presidential election]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-44852812 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Communications in Iran#Internet|Communications in Iran]]
**[[Iran]]ian police arrest 46 people in fresh crackdowns on models and associated colleagues posting "immoral images" on [[Instagram]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/entertainment/iran-arrests-46-in-fresh-crackdowns-on-instagram-models/2018/07/16/28ae7740-8912-11e8-9d59-dccc2c0cabcf_story.html (''Washington Post'')]
*[[Russian espionage in the United States]]
**The [[Federal government of the United States|US government]] charges [[Maria Butina]], a 29-year-old [[Russians|Russian]] woman with conspiracy to act as a Russian government agent while infiltrating political groups. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2018/jul/16/maria-butina-charged-spying-russia-us-doj (''The Guardian'')]
*Finbar Charles, a 62-year-old citizen of [[Saint Lucia]], pleads guilty to bribing [[United States Army|US Army]] officers for military contracts during the [[Iraq War]]. [https://www.al.com/news/index.ssf/2018/07/businessman_pleads_guilty_to_b.html (AL)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Khoisan#Declaration of sovereignty|Khoisan § Declaration of sovereignty]]
**King Khoebaha Calvin Cornelius III declares independence from [[South Africa]] to form the "Sovereign State of Good Hope", encompassing the states of [[Northern Cape]], [[Western Cape]], and the western parts of [[Eastern Cape]]. The state raised their own flag after taking down the [[Flag of South Africa|South African flag]]. [https://citizen.co.za/news/south-africa/1982550/khoi-san-king-declares-that-the-cape-has-seceded-from-sa/ (''The Citizen'')]
